promise: Bring the Kigali Amendment phasing down HFCs into force on 1 January 2019
description: The Kigali Amendment was adopted on October 15, 2016. The twentieth ratification was reached on November 17, 2017, allowing entry into force on January 1, 2019. It provides a phased reduction of HFC consumption and production, rather than an immediate ban.
evidence: UNEP records entry into force on January 1, 2019.
